name: Shanon Melloway
original_name: シャノン・メロウェイ
source:
[i]"I may have spoiled her a little too much. I must punish her once I find her."[/i]

[i]Immoral Educator[/i]

The heroine's guardian. Her bewitching beauty captivates many, and she lives a life unbound by any person or thing. She took in the heroine on a whim after the latter lost her parents, but she's never spoiled her.

She treats the heroine like a servant, forcing various household affairs on her with strict demeanor. The heroine, meanwhile, admires her strength. Their relationship is a peculiar but positive one. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=shanon]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
